q: What if Qortal Web Builder can't connect to my wallet?
a: QWB can only sign in when opened inside Qortal Hub or GO, for example from the Apps list or qortal://APP/QWB, not as a file in a normal browser. Wait a second after it opens and tap Connect again. If it still fails, update Hub, and use Run bridge diagnostics to copy details for support.

q: How do I add a poster to my title on Subscreen?
a: On the Publish page or in Edit, drop an image or tap to choose one: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB, ideally vertical 2:3, and crop it to the poster shape. It shows on posters in Subscreen and as the thumbnail in Q-Tube. Without one, the first snapshot of the video is used.

q: Is Subscreen the same as Q-Tube?
a: No, but they share data. Subscreen shows the Movies and Series from Q-Tube's format, and what you publish in Subscreen is published in Q-Tube's format under your name, so it appears in both, with the same comment thread. Subscreen adds things for films and shows: ratings out of 10, cast & crew, collections, bookmarks lists and tips.

q: How does Q-Drive encrypt my files?
a: Each file, its name and type, and your folder list are encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before anything is published, so nodes that store them see encrypted data only. Nothing private goes into the public QDN details such as titles or tags. Qortal's own encryption layer keeps nothing secret by itself; all of Q-Drive's privacy comes from this encryption on your device.

q: What happens to my Q-Drive if I lose my Qortal account?
a: Your drive key is encrypted to your Qortal account, so only that account, and people you shared files with, can open your files. Restore the same account from your seed phrase on any device and your drive opens again. If the seed phrase is lost, nobody can recover the account or the drive; this can't be undone, so keep your seed phrase backed up offline.

q: Do I need a registered name for Q-MEME or GIFs?
a: Yes, to publish or like. Both apps save your memes, GIFs and likes to QDN under your registered name, so without one they ask you to register a name in Hub or GO first. Browsing, saving and copying work without a name.

q: Does the person I share with need Q-Drive?
aliases: q-drive share to someone without drive
a: They need a Qortal account with a registered name, because you share by typing their name, and they open the files in Q-Drive inside Hub or GO. They don't need a drive of their own: Shared with me works without one, and seeing what was shared costs them nothing. If they don't use Qortal apps at all, Q-Mail with the file attached (up to 40 MB) is the other way.

q: Is there a storage limit in Q-Drive?
a: QDN has no quota, so Q-Drive shows no bar. Its storage meter just lists your files and their size, the trash on its own line, and the encrypted size on QDN. The limits are per file (2000 MB, or 500 MB on a public node) and the 0.01 QORT fee for each publish. Your files also need nodes that keep them, ideally your own.

q: Why can't I open a Q-Drive share link?
a: Check the message Q-Drive shows. "Only the person it was shared with can open it" or "Not for this account" means you are signed in with another account or name. "This share was stopped" means the sender stopped it. "Fetching from peers…" or "Not found on your node yet" means it hasn't reached your node: wait and retry. Also check that the whole link was copied; Q-Drive links look like qortal://APP/Q-Drive/s/…

q: Why can't I select my name in Subscreen?
a: Subscreen can't use names that contain #, ?, / or % yet. If your name has one of these, pick another of your names in the account menu, or register a plain name in Hub, to rate, comment and publish.

q: Can buyers leave reviews in a QWB Q-Shop?
a: Yes. Each product's detail window has a Reviews tab, but a review can only be written after a purchase of that product recorded in the buyer's browser from checkout. That keeps reviews to people who actually bought.

q: Does Help Host Map Tiles in World Map make my node host the map?
aliases: world map help host map tiles
a: Help Host Map Tiles lets you pick the map data publishers, and World Map saves your choice as a list on your node. Your node stores a name's data for others when you follow that name, so to be sure you help, also follow those publisher names on your own node. Hosting needs your own node; a public node doesn't host for you.
source: ~/Desktop/World Map/q-app/index.html, qortal.js (map_data_publishers list); Core lists: followedNames

q: How do I contribute map tiles to World Map?
aliases: world map contribute to map quality
a: Tap Contribute to Map Quality to open Publish Tiles. Pick the name to publish under and choose PNG, JPG or WebP tile files: each identifier comes from the file name or path, such as 12-2207-1297.png or tiles/12/2207/1297.png. Tiles you already published are skipped, and the rest go out as QDN images in one batch you approve in Hub.

q: How do I suggest a meetup with someone on ThankQ?
a: Open their meetup post and tap Suggest a Meetup. Pick the kind (coffee, walk, chat, dinner, local tour, hike, co-work or event), roughly when, and write a message, then Send Suggestion. ThankQ publishes it and tells them by Q-Chat and Q-Mail, and it shows in their Requests, Incoming.

q: What does Hide Incomplete Listings do on ThankQ?
a: Some listings on QDN are missing details, for example a publish that didn't finish, and ThankQ shows them as incomplete cards asking the host to republish. Tick Hide Incomplete Listings in Explore to leave those out and see only complete listings.

q: What is the POS app on Qortal?
a: The Q-App named POS is an old test version that is no longer worked on. The point-of-sale app to use is POS+, a separate Q-App: search for POS+ in the Apps list of Hub or GO.
source: QDN APP POS metadata ("Old test version of POS"), APP POS+

q: Can I get back a file I deleted forever in Q-Drive?
a: Often, yes, because Delete forever only takes the file off your drive and its encrypted data stays on QDN. Open Settings, Storage, Find missing files and ask it to show files deleted earlier; adding one back puts it in your drive again as a change you save. It only works while nodes still have that file's data.

q: Why didn't my Singularity score save?
a: Check the message under the game. You need a registered name, at least one minted block, and a run that beats your verified best. If you declined in Hub, or the publish timed out, look for Hub's approval prompt and tap Save verified score again. A saved score can take a moment to show on the leaderboard while it reaches your node.

q: Is Q-Shops the same as the Q-Shop app?
a: No. Q-Shops gathers the stores that people build with the Q-Shop block of Qortal Web Builder, reading the catalogs their websites publish. The Q-Shop Q-App is a separate shop app with its own stores, so its shops don't appear in Q-Shops.

q: How do I edit, remove or share my place on World Map?
a: Open your own place on the map: its popup has Comments, Edit, Remove and Copy / chat. Edit opens the same form as Add POI. Remove marks the place as deleted so World Map stops showing it, although earlier versions stay on QDN. Copy / chat copies the place's title, region and coordinates, and can also send them as a chat message to a Qortal address you type.

q: Why can't I find my website on Qortal Web?
aliases: qwb site not on qortal web
a: Give the network a little while after you publish: Qortal Web reads the index file your site publishes, and other nodes need to fetch it. A group-only site shows only to signed-in members of that group. Sites published with older QWB versions may need Publish Website once more, so the index carries what newer Qortal Web expects.
source: ~/Desktop/Qortal Web Builder/qortal-web-app/CHANGELOG.md v0.0.26, README.md (Publishing & access control)

q: How do people visit my QWB website?
a: Share its link, qortal://WEBSITE/<your name>, which QWB shows after publishing. Visitors open it in Qortal Hub or Qortal GO; it won't open in an ordinary web browser. A Global site is also listed in the Qortal Web Q-App, where people can find it by search.

q: Does ThankQ show listings on a map?
a: Yes. Explore shows listings beside a map with pins coloured by kind: available host, full host, meetup and event travel. Listings need coordinates, or a city and country ThankQ can place, to appear as pins. You can also show ThankQ's pins inside the World Map Q-App.
